title: 3-Day Strength & Tone Split (12 Weeks)
author: Coach Dave
desc: A structured 12-week, 3-day full body split designed for consistent strength and muscle tone. Each workout features 3-4 foundational movements performed for 3 sets of 10 reps across the board.

variations.name: default
days: Day 1: Upper Push / Pull & Posterior Hinge

ex.note: Control the eccentric, full lockout.
Drive elbows down to hips, controlled stretch at the top.
Hinge at the hips, slight soft knee bend, feel hamstrings load.
Seated or standing dumbbell overhead press. Smooth lockout.
Seated cable row. Squeeze shoulder blades together.
Full depth squat. Push knees out over toes.
Tricep pushdowns on cable. Keep elbows pinned at sides.
Dumbbell curls. Controlled lower on each rep.
Leg extension. Hold top squeeze for 1 second.
Leg curl. Smooth controlled cadence.
